content.title: Tickets to Sabrina Carpenter at Coachella: Friday prices, stage times and more for 2026 festival | Sporting News
content.text: If you purchase a product or register for an account through one of the links on our site, we may receive compensation. Learn more > You can't have Coachella without Sabrina Carpenter. The pop icon will take the stage in the valley this year, headlining Friday's lineup for two special nights.Last time Carpenter took the stage in 2024, a new era of pop music began as she performed "Espresso" for the first time. Just a few months later, she was selling out arenas all over the world.BUY NOW: Get tickets to Coachella 2026 on StubHubAre you ready for a "House Tour" in the desert? Sabrina Carpenter will show you around.If you want some last-minute tickets to see her at Coachella, here's how you can get Friday tickets for Weekend 2 of the festival.Tickets to Sabrina Carpenter at CoachellaTickets: StubHubTickets to every day of Coachella are available now on StubHub!Sabrina Carpenter will perform on both Fridays during the festival. Those that want to see her can purchase three-day passes or single-day passes to the festival.Currently, Weekend 2 costs $3,300 for a Friday-only pass and $2,200 for a three-day ticket. Click below for an updated look at availability. Sabrina Carpenter at Coachella date, set timeSabrina Carpenter will perform at Coachella on Friday, April 10 and Friday, April 17.On Weekend 1, she will perform at 9:00 p.m. PT on Coachella Stage.Coachella 2026 lineupThe Coachella 2026 lineup is here.
